description: This PHP class models the supervisor information of an employee within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It implements serialization logic for exposing supervisor and reporting method details via the API and constructs its data representation based on the ReportTo entity.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing supervisor and reporting method data related to an employee, implementing normalization for API output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReportTo entity and defines filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
